2026.headline: Eighteen autopicks, and a 2-1 record anyway
story: Johnny4Skins took Ja'Marr Chase and Lamar Jackson in the first two rounds, then, apparently, went to dinner. The autopick drafted eighteen of his players, tied with Painty69 for the most in the league, including Jalen Hurts, A.J. Brown, Tyler Warren, Kyren Williams, Brian Thomas and DK Metcalf. Not a single human opinion went into any of them.

It has worked. He lost to Zygon in Week 1, then beat Painty69 in Week 2 and posted the best score of Week 3, 158.46, over Snipe58. His efficiency is 85 percent, safely above the league's lower tier, and his $500 of FAAB is untouched, which the desk now treats as an identity.
The roster is dual-QB by design or by accident. The honest answer is that it does not matter until an injury forces a decision. He also has a new handle: the account was Cassellrole until October.
takes: A good autopick is still not a plan.
